subject: Flood relief in a north Indian village during the monsoon. Brown water lies over the fields and laps at the plinths of the mud houses. In the foreground a country boat is being poled up to a doorway, loaded with sacks of grain, while villagers hand them up to a family sitting on a thatched roof with their goat. Two men wade with a child on their shoulders. Heavy grey-blue monsoon sky with slanting rain and a single white egret. The composition ordered in flat horizontal bands, figures small against the water.
